Class StateSpace<SD>

java.lang.Object
jsdp.sdp.StateSpace<SD>
Type Parameters:
SD - a specific state descriptor for the problem at hand.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<State>
Direct Known Subclasses:
BR_StateSpace, BRF_StateSpace, BRL_StateSpace, CF_StateSpace, sS_StateSpace, StateSpaceImpl, StateSpaceImpl
public abstract class StateSpace<SD> extends Object implements Iterable<State>
An abstract container that stores all generated State.
Author:
Roberto Rossi

  • Constructor Details

    • StateSpace

      public StateSpace(int period, HashType hash)
      Constructs a container for states associated with a given period. Do not use ConcurrentHashMap in conjunction with forward recursion.
      Parameters:
      period - the period associated with this container.
      hash - the type of hash used to store the state space

    • StateSpace

      public StateSpace(int period, HashType hash, int stateSpaceSizeLowerBound, float loadFactor)
      Constructs a container for states associated with a given period. Do not use ConcurrentHashMap in conjunction with forward recursion.
      Parameters:
      period - the period associated with this container.
      hash - the type of hash used to store the state space
      stateSpaceSizeLowerBound - a lower bound for the sdp state space size, used to initialise the internal hash maps
      loadFactor - the internal hash maps load factor
